question: Let $A = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix}$. Compute $A^2$, $B^2$, $AB$, $BA$, and verify whether $AB = BA$ and if $A$ and $B$ commute under multiplication.
explanation:
Calculate $A^2$:

$A^2 = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}4 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 \end{pmatrix} = 4I$

Calculate $B^2$:

$B^2 = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix} = I$

Calculate $AB$:

$= \begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}0 \times 1 + 2 \times 0 & 0 \times 0 + 2 \times (-1) \\ 2 \times 1 + 0 \times 0 & 2 \times 0 + 0 \times (-1)\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}0 & -2 \\ 2 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$

Calculate $BA$:

$= \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 \end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}1 \times 0 + 0 \times 2 & 1 \times 2 + 0 \times 0 \\ 0 \times 0 + (-1) \times 2 & 0 \times 2 + (-1) \times 0\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ -2 & 0\end{pmatrix}$

Compare $AB \neq BA$.

Conclusion: $A$ and $B$ do not commute under multiplication.

options.D: $A^2=4I$, $B^2=I$, $AB=\begin{pmatrix}0&-2\\2&0\end{pmatrix}$, $BA=\begin{pmatrix}0&2\\-2&0\end{pmatrix}$, so $AB\ne BA$ and $A,B$ do not commute
